name: 1-start-here
title: Start here: the whole model
subtitle: How to read the model site: what the link opened, where the layers are, how to show one layer at a time, and which question each whole-model view answers.

steps.label: OPENED FROM ITS LINK
steps.text: The site opened the model file from its link. Edits stay in this browser; Save or Export keeps them.

steps.label: PROPOSE A CHANGE
steps.text: Propose a change leads to the repository's guide: changes come back through GitHub, by a branch or a fork and a pull request.

steps.label: HIDE THE MESSAGE
steps.text: × hides the strip. Reloading the page fetches the model afresh and drops unsaved edits.

steps.label: THE EXPLORER
steps.text: Kinds and Common hold what every layer shares. OA, SA, LA, PA and EPBS are the layers, from operations down to the product breakdown.

steps.label: THE VIEW TABS
steps.text: Each tab shows the same model another way: diagrams, then tables, then analyses. General is open.

steps.label: FOLD THE BOTTOM PANEL
steps.text: Problems, Text and more share the bottom panel. ▾ folds it down to its tabs, for more diagram.

steps.label: GENERAL VIEW: THE WHOLE MODEL
steps.text: Unscoped, General draws all 845 boxes, the layers side by side from OA on the left to EPBS. ⤢ Fit shrinks them to specks, too small to read.

steps.label: ZOOM IN AND SELECT
steps.text: Wheel-zoom until the boxes read, then select one: the path above the canvas says where it lives. This one, taskSurveillanceArea, is in SA.

steps.label: SHOW ONE LAYER AT A TIME
steps.text: So read one layer at a time: ⊞ beside a package shows only it in the diagrams. The chip above the canvas names it, here OA.

steps.label: OA ON ITS OWN
steps.text: OA alone is 138 boxes. Select one and ◎ Selection zooms to it: SwarmMember, the drone. Properties shows its documentation.

steps.label: MOVE A BOX
steps.text: Drag a box and it stays where you drop it, through edits and view switches; its lines follow. Dropping it onto another box would move it inside that box.

steps.label: AUTO-LAYOUT
steps.text: Auto-layout forgets the boxes moved by hand and lays the view out afresh, left to right.

steps.label: BACK TO THE WHOLE MODEL
steps.text: × on the chip shows the whole model again. Laying out all 845 boxes takes a few seconds.

steps.label: OPEN ANALYSIS
steps.text: Analysis turns all 1361 elements into one network and ranks them. On the whole model that takes a couple of seconds.

steps.label: ANALYSIS
steps.text: What holds the model together? Dots are elements, sized by their links; labels are thinned so none overlap. Hubs keep theirs: SwarmMember, dutyController.

steps.label: REQUIREMENTS TABLE
steps.text: What must hold, and what satisfies it? 49 requirements with their text and Satisfied By. Verified By is still empty in this model.

steps.label: ALLOCATION MATRIX
steps.text: Which part performs which function? 106 functions against 23 parts, a tick per allocation: issueTasking goes to dutyController.

steps.label: SEQUENCE
steps.text: Who sends what to whom, in order? Each flow is an arrow between lifelines. The first, handOverSectorAtoB: memberA proposes a sector handover to memberB.

steps.label: GRID
steps.text: What is each element, and of what type? One row per element: here DetectionReport and its attributes, each with its type.

steps.label: CONTRACTS
steps.text: What does each requirement assume and guarantee? DroneAirframeContract assumes a full charge at the start; it guarantees endurance and speed.

steps.label: THE MODEL AS TEXT
steps.text: The Text tab holds the whole model as SysML-like text, kept in sync: a change made in a diagram shows up here. Parse warnings fold to one line under it.

outro.title: Foundations — Kinds and Common
outro.text: The #Tag keywords every layer uses, and the definitions every layer shares. The live model: cosmindxu.github.io/mbse-workflow
